sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail of Dietary Supplements and Nutraceuticals Online

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (constitutional parliamentary democracy with common-law-based business statutes and customary law; corporate law primarily modeled on U.S. Delaware and Nevada corporate law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Government of the United States and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Title Two economic provisions
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) trade in goods framework
Limited bilateral investment and double-taxation agreement network; reliance on general international law and domestic investment incentives

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Regulations 2013; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit directives and implementation guidelines; Business License Act 1996, as amended

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or government-issued national identity card for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in the country of origin or a duly licensed notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization depending on jurisdiction of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized bank reference letter or source-of-funds certificate for each principal beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or licensed financial institution in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for jurisdictions not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential or business address (e.g., utility bill, lease agreement, or bank statement) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relevant utility provider, landlord, or financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and, where required, Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Clearance or name reservation certificate issued by the RMI Registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization when presented to foreign banks or regulatory authorities

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence before incorporation and on any change in ownership: all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories must be screened against the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit domestic list, U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, and EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List. PEP status must be assessed for all individuals with 25% or greater ownership, including immediate family members and close associates. Adverse media, source-of-wealth, source-of-funds, and jurisdiction-risk screening is required. The AML/CFT compliance officer or registered agent must sign off on the file before incorporation, and records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry / Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations online filing system (accessed exclusively through a licensed registered agent portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be rendered in Latin script using English-language characters. Non-English names are permitted only when submitted with an official English transliteration; the English transliteration is the controlling corporate name. Chinese or other non-Latin names cannot be used as the sole official corporate name and may appear only as a parallel informal trade name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant's licensed registered agent may file a written request for administrative reconsideration within 14 calendar days, with supporting evidence such as letters of consent or a disclaimed similarity analysis. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may lodge a formal appeal to the Registrar's appellate committee within 30 days, and thereafter seek judicial review by originating application to the RMI High Court. The original name-reservation fee is not refunded on rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement only if a licensed RMI registered agent maintains a physical street address in Majuro and accepts service of process at that address. For a cross-border dietary-supplement e-commerce business classified as high risk for AML/CFT purposes, a virtual office alone is not sufficient for a high-risk merchant account or for obtaining a domestic business license. The acquiring bank and RMI Business Licensing Authority will ordinarily require demonstrable commercial substance, including a physical or staffed presence, records location, and compliance personnel.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk (approximately 70% within the first 12 months). Unannounced inspections are reasonably likely because the entity is engaged in cross-border online sales of nutraceuticals and dietary supplements, which triggers enhanced AML/CFT scrutiny and business-license compliance inspections. The RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and the Business Licensing Authority may also request immediate access to corporate records and UBO files.

Business Corporation incorporation filing fee (non-resident, no minimum capital)

Notarization of incorporation instruments, director/UBO identification documents, and source-of-funds evidence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille authentication of the notarized corporate and KYC document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in the country of document origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular fee or prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance consultant or registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-subject screening fee and adverse-media due-diligence benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Business Licensing Authority / Ministry of Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Business License Act statutory license fee benchmark for high-risk commercial activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: High-risk merchant account and acquiring bank readiness assessment (payment rails: credit card and high-risk merchant account)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML consultant, independent sales organization, or merchant services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for high-risk e-commerce veterinary/allied health and nutraceutical merchants

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial-substance arrangement and unannounced-inspection preparedness (physical compliance file and records-retention agreement)
Ongoing UBO register and AML/CFT maintenance deposit for the first year

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (Title 27, Marshall Islands Revised Statutes); applicable provisions include the articles of incorporation, corporate purpose, registered office and registered agent, issuance of shares, and election and powers of directors and officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Office of the Attorney General, Majuro), acting through a licensed RMI registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form filed pursuant to the Business Corporations Act 1990).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement for a Marshall Islands Business Corporation; shares may be issued for consideration fixed by the Board, and capital may be nominal or zero for a non-resident corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription and issue to the incorporator the authorized shares of common stock upon payment of the consideration fixed by the Board, such shares fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that the registered agent be approved to accept service of process. RESOLVED, that [Director A], [Director B], and [Director C] are appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, to serve until the next annual meeting and until successors are elected and qualified. RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to open bank and merchant accounts, execute e-commerce agreements, and complete all ancillary filings for the Corporation's operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI (submission via licensed registered agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name (ending in 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Ltd.' or 'Inc.') for distinguishability screening against the RMI corporate register. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing reserved or registered name. Upon clearance, reserve the name for up to 60 days pending incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar or submit two alternative names for same-day accelerated re-screening.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator with notarization by an RMI-authorized notary public or licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Articles of Incorporation containing: (i) corporate name; (ii) general purpose clause covering e-commerce retail of dietary supplements and nutraceuticals; (iii) authorized share structure; (iv) registered office in Majuro; (v) registered agent consent; and (vi) incorporator signature and acknowledgment. Execute the document in duplicate, with one copy retained for the corporate records book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material errors in the executed Articles are cured by pre-filing rescission or by a Certificate of Correction filed with the Registrar; no penalty is imposed where correction is sought before issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and payment of state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Articles of Incorporation and registered agent consent through the licensed registered agent. Pay the US$250.00 statutory filing fee and select standard (5 business day) or expedited (24-hour) processing. The filing triggers the issuance of a Certificate of Incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, respond with corrective Articles or written submissions within 14 days; where the response is late, re-file with an additional US$100.00 administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the corporate number, exact name, incorporation date, and official seal. Verify all details against the executed Articles and order certified copies for bank, merchant account, and e-commerce platform due diligence purposes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the Certificate are rectified through a Certificate of Correction; substantive changes require Amended Articles of Incorporation to be filed and adopted by the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and adoption of bylaws and board resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (internal corporate organ); notarized consent for bank verification where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or execute a unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting to approve the bylaws and the First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, officer appointments, bank account opening, and execution authority for e-commerce and high-risk merchant agreements.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution / unanimous written consent
Directors' consents and due diligence questionnaires
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective pre-incorporation acts may be ratified by a subsequent board resolution under the Business Corporations Act implied ratification rule; execute a corrective written consent immediately upon discovery.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered office and agent confirmation and franchise tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent; Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office address in Majuro and the appointment of the licensed registered agent. The agent files the first annual franchise tax return (minimum US$250.00) by September 30 of each calendar year and maintains the corporation in good standing. Obtain the franchise tax receipt for the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late franchise tax filing attracts a 10% penalty plus interest; good standing may be reinstated within six months by payment of all arrears and penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax status confirmation and foreign investment business licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Tax Administration (Ministry of Finance) and Foreign Investment Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a non-resident tax declaration confirming no RMI-source income for the offshore e-commerce corporation. Where any physical presence in the RMI is contemplated, apply for a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL). For wholly offshore cross-border operations, obtain a written exemption or clearance confirmation from the Foreign Investment Registrar.
required_dossiers: Non-resident tax declaration / tax clearance application
E-commerce business plan for nutraceutical retail
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the FIBL is denied, appeal to the Minister of Finance within 30 days or amend the business plan to remove all local physical activity and re-file as pure cross-border e-commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental and public health compliance registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA) and Ministry of Health and Human Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a low-impact Environmental Compliance Statement for the digital-only retail activity and register any distribution micro-hub or warehouse, if any. Obtain nutraceutical import and resale clearance from the Ministry of Health and Human Services, covering label disclosure, ingredient safety, and prohibition of controlled substances.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: EPA non-compliance notices are cured by submitting a waste and emissions management plan within 21 days; health clearance appeals are heard by the Minister for Health.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: RMI Foreign Investment Registrar (Ministry of Finance); RMI Ministry of Health and Human Services (nutraceutical regulatory clearance); RMI Environmental Protection Authority; Majuro Atoll Local Government Business License Office (for any local physical nexus).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License - E-Commerce Retail of Dietary Supplements and Nutraceuticals (ISIC 4791), with supplementary Food Supplement Import and Resale Clearance

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Low Impact Registration; exempt from full Environmental Impact Assessment where no manufacturing or in-country warehousing occurs; an Environmental Compliance Statement is submitted in lieu of a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater discharge and zero VOC or fugitive emissions for pure e-commerce operations; any RMI distribution micro-hub must comply with RMI EPA groundwater protection, waste segregation, and open-burning prohibitions; unsold or expired supplement inventory must be rendered unfit for consumption and disposed through EPA-approved waste streams; packaging must meet RMI imported packaging and marine debris prevention standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire Authority (structural fire-load inspection for any warehouse or office); building structural clearance from the RMI Public Works and Infrastructure Division; workplace health and safety clearance from the RMI Occupational Health and Safety Board for any locally engaged employees; wholly remote and digital operations require only a written self-certification of no physical occupational footprint.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Customs and Revenue Division), Majuro, with corporate registration administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations (RMI Corporate Registry). No dedicated national income-tax administration portal exists because the RMI levies no income, corporate, or VAT/GST tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities are not issued a domestic TIN or VAT ID. The operative statutory tax identifier is the Tax Exemption Certificate (TEC) issued under the Business Corporations Act (BCCA), obtained through a licensed Registered Agent and the Registrar of Corporations, accompanied by a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) where foreign ownership engages in local activity. For a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC), the TEC is the sole tax identity instrument; no tax filings or returns are required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone / Territorial_Scope: A Non-Resident Domestic Corporation is expressly exempt from all income tax, franchise tax, and other taxes of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, including any tax computed on gross revenue, provided no business is carried on within RMI territory and no local-source income is derived.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable: the RMI has no check-the-box entity election system, no hybrid mismatch election, and no regime analogous to U.S. Subchapter S. The only relevant election is the irrevocable statutory selection of non-resident status under BCCA, which fixes the tax-exempt classification for the corporation's existence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax. The RMI imposes only customs import duties (tariffs) on goods entering the territory and municipal business license fees for physical operation within Majuro or other municipalities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no indirect tax registration threshold exists. Import duty registration arises only when the entity physically imports goods into RMI customs territory; an NRDC engaged solely in cross-border e-commerce and offshore export of nutraceutical supplements has no indirect-tax nexus and no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, API clearance, or digital stamping mandate exists in the RMI. Commercial invoices and pro forma invoices are retained purely as banking and customs evidence; no government-side fiscal clearance of invoices is required for export transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: absent a VAT/GST system there is no export zero-rating to claim and no VAT refund mechanism. Exports of dietary supplements and nutraceuticals from the RMI are not subject to any export duty, sales tax, or indirect tax. An NRDC should nevertheless maintain documentary proof that title, risk, and control pass to foreign customers, and that goods never enter RMI customs territory, to preserve the BCCA tax-exempt status and satisfy high-risk acquiring banks.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (filed only where goods transit RMI customs territory; otherwise a General Export Certificate or exemption letter)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment from origin to foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or acquiring-bank settlement statement evidencing foreign-source payment flow
Commercial Invoice with HS/ISIC code 4791 scope description
Certificate of Origin (or supplier's declaration for nutraceutical raw materials)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although no VAT refund clawback is possible in the RMI, false certification of non-resident or export status, or submission of forged customs or banking documents, triggers: (i) revocation of the Tax Exemption Certificate and retroactive assessment of any taxes that would otherwise have been due (limited to municipal fees and import duties); (ii) monetary fines under the Business Corporations Act; and (iii) criminal penalties for fraud, perjury, and money laundering under the Criminal Code and the Anti-Money Laundering (Amendment) Act, including imprisonment. High-Risk_Merchant_Account acquirers additionally reserve contractual clawback rights for chargebacks and documentary non-compliance, which may result in holdback forfeiture and termination of payment processing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Not applicable – the Republic of the Marshall Islands has no central bank. The de facto banking and foreign exchange regulator is the Republic of the Marshall Islands Banking Commission, established under the Banking Act 1991, with supervisory oversight through the Minister of Finance. The official legal tender is the U.S. Dollar.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands utilises the U.S. Dollar as sole legal tender. There are no exchange control regulations, no distinction between current and capital account treatment, and no convertibility restrictions. Dividends, profit remittances, capital repatriation and direct investment outflows are fully free without Central Bank approval, subject only to commercial bank AML/CFT due diligence and FATF-aligned sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export proceeds surrender rules exist in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Exporters are not required to convert or repatriate export receipts within any statutory timeline. Export proceeds may be retained in USD offshore or onshore at the exporter's discretion; however, domestic banks may require supporting trade documentation such as invoices, bills of lading, and customs entries for value greater than USD 10,000.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. The Marshall Islands does not maintain a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs and payment fintechs cannot obtain a direct membership in USD domestic clearing or access the Federal Reserve/CHIPS system. Non-resident fintech charters recognised under Marshall Islands corporate law do not carry banking or clearing-house privileges. For a high-risk cross-border nutraceutical e-commerce operation, engagement with an offshore EMI is legally possible but commercially impracticable due to downstream correspondent bank de-risking and incompatibility with domestic bank KYC expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors may complete onboarding remotely for a non-resident Business Corporation, provided the registered agent provides verification and all UBOs submit notarised identification. However, due to the High_Risk_Special_License classification of nutraceutical cross-border e-commerce, domestic commercial banks require at least one executive director or designated compliance officer to appear in person at a bank branch in Majuro or Ebeye, or alternatively attend a secure video interview with a licensed notary witnessing the execution of account-opening resolutions. Bank policies that insist on physical presence for high-risk non-resident entities are common.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk product category – dietary supplements and nutraceuticals sold cross-border, subject to adverse media and chargeback exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid statutory business licence; product registration certificates from country of manufacture; ISO/GMP certification; full supply chain contracts from raw-material supplier to distributor; laboratory analysis reports; customer-dispute resolution procedures; merchant acquirer underwriting package; PCI DSS compliance certificate; and profit-and-loss projections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no physical operating assets or employees in the Marshall Islands
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of good standing from the Registrar of Corporations; registered agent and registered office certificate; corporate charter and bylaws; board resolution appointing a local liaison director; evidence of purpose; legal opinion confirming non-resident tax status; and if relying on economic substance exemption, a sworn declaration of offshore management and control.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious transaction pattern – concentrated inbound wire transfers followed by rapid outbound disbursements to suppliers in multiple foreign jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow waterfall forecast for first 12 months; board-approved treasury policy; supplier due-diligence files including licences, bank references, and UBO details for all counterparties; invoice reconciliation trail proving trade settlement; anti-money-laundering compliance manual; appointment of an external AML compliance officer; and a documented rationale for each proposed disbursement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections must be routed by wire transfer in U.S. Dollars through the international banking system to the RMI bank account. Each transfer must clearly reference the Board Resolution authorising the capital contribution and use a payment purpose code consistent with direct investment or intercompany capital contribution (e.g., 'Capital Contribution' in SWIFT field 70). The sending bank must be a recognised correspondent with the RMI bank; pre-advice and OFAC/FATF screening are mandatory. The RMI bank will request the underlying corporate resolutions, source-of-funds evidence, and a capital account escrow agreement before crediting funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for nutraceutical supplier settlements should use SWIFT MT103 for payments below USD 500,000 or when immediate settlement is required. For higher-value bulk raw-material purchases, a Commercial Letter of Credit (documentary credit under UCP600) is recommended, with settlement via MT103 upon compliant presentation of shipping and customs documents. USD clearing is executed through U.S. correspondent banks using Fedwire/CHIPS. All outbound transfers must include the commercial invoice number, purchase order reference, supplier legal name and bank beneficial-owner details.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/EUR forward contracts maturing up to 12 months
USD/AUD cross-currency swaps for fixed-term hedging
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in exotic Asian currencies when trading counterparties settle in restrictive-currency jurisdictions
Average-rate forwards for USD against GBP, CHF and JPY to smooth daily trade settlement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report (statement of company name, registered office, resident agent, directors, officers and shareholder list)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; the report must be filed on or before the annual anniversary date of the corporation. No uniform calendar date applies to all corporations.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 100.00; failure to file for two consecutive years empowers the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Payment based on authorised share capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation, concurrently with the Annual Corporation Report.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interest accrues at 1.5 percent per month on the unpaid amount; continued non-payment for two consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and loss of legal existence for cross-border e-commerce transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation. There are no revenue, asset, turnover or shareholder-count thresholds that automatically require an audit. An independent certified audit may become contractually mandatory under the high-risk merchant agreement, a nutraceuticals e-commerce license condition, a payment processor requirement, or if shareholders holding at least 10% of outstanding votes duly pass a resolution requiring one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No domestic GAAP is prescribed. The corporation may adopt IFRS or US GAAP, provided that accounting records fairly disclose its financial position, enable identification of transactions, and support the preparation of the Annual Corporation Report.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Marshall Islands law does not mandatory require a government UBO register or an annual UBO declaration. The Annual Corporation Report confirms current directors, officers, resident agent and registered office only. For ISIC_4791 online retail of nutraceuticals, the acquiring bank and high-risk credit-card processor will contractually require an annual beneficial ownership attestation identifying all natural persons who directly or indirectly own 10% or more of the entity, and require written confirmation within 15 business days of any shareholding transfer. This UBO protocol is refreshed every annual anniversary as a condition to merchant account eligibility.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; USD 4,000 – USD 8,000 if mandated by a high-risk merchant license or payment-acquiring institution.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory corporate income tax holiday is granted; the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act applies a strictly territorial system. A non-resident domestic Business Corporation is chargeable only on income derived from sources within the Republic, and all foreign-source cross-border nutraceutical retail income falls outside the charging provisions. The resulting effective tax rate on such foreign income is nil.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporation Report (Form 02) filed through the Marshall Islands Online Filing System of the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation; the statutory filing anchor is the charter anniversary, not the fiscal year-end. A non-resident corporation with no Marshall Islands-source income is not required to file an annual income tax return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The exact registered English legal name appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the legal name only; no local trade name disclosure is required unless separately registered under the Business Names Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and Marshall Islands street address of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be an RMI-licensed agent with a physical address in Majuro; foreign mailing addresses are not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name and residential address of each director and officer in office as of the filing date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all non-resident directors and officers; RMI law imposes no local residency or nationality requirement for a Business Corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorised shares, par value per share, and aggregate authorised capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reproduce the figures from the certificate of incorporation; if no par value, state 'no par value' and total number of shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation is a non-resident domestic corporation and has not derived Marshall Islands-source income during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the declaration to preserve territorial tax exemption. For a cross-border supplement vendor, affirm that no RMI banking account, physical sales office, or local revenue generation occurred.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a statutory late fee per month or partial month, plus a reinstatement fee if the Registrar dissolves the corporation. Failure to cure within 90 days triggers administrative dissolution and loss of all corporate rights; a dissolved company cannot lawfully maintain or obtain credit-card merchant processing until reinstatement is completed.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement and therefore operates no domestic DTA relief mechanism. A non-resident shareholder claiming foreign tax credits must submit a valid tax residency certificate issued by the shareholder's residence authority to that authority; the RMI will not endorse or process a TRC because no withholding tax is imposed at source on dividend payments from an RMI Business Corporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% treaty rate for outbound royalties and interest; no RMI withholding tax is imposed on payments for intellectual property licences, brand royalties, or related-party financing.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold or Local File/Master File obligation exists under RMI law. As a best-practice benchmark for a cross-border nutraceutical supply chain, arm's length documentation should be prepared when controlled transactions exceed USD 1,000,000 in annual value.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has not enacted OECD-style Economic Substance Regulations and does not apply ESR to a non-resident Business Corporation. Nevertheless, foreign tax authorities may invoke substance-over-form to pierce the structure if management, procurement, payment routing, and customer operations are physically directed from the shareholder's residence country. Board meetings, bank accounts, supplier contracts, and record-keeping should therefore be situated in the jurisdiction where the shareholder asserts tax residence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in a Foreign Tax Jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Relocating nutraceutical e-commerce profits to an RMI non-resident corporation without a valid commercial purpose while the beneficial owner remains tax-resident in a high-tax jurisdiction and directs the cross-border merchant account from that jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign revenue authorities may recharacterise the arrangement as a sham and impose fraud penalties of 100–200% of the understated tax, interest, and criminal fines up to USD 500,000. The RMI Registrar may additionally strike off the company for filing a false exemption declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false declarations or divert foreign sales proceeds face civil restitution of all concealed profits, personal travel bans while foreign tax warrants are outstanding, and imprisonment of up to seven years under the prosecuting jurisdiction's tax laws.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining no physical office, no local employees, and no substantive decision-making in the Marshall Islands while using the Business Corporation as a pure invoicing shell for dietary supplement sales into high-tax consumer markets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A court or tax agency may disregard the RMI entity, apply CFC or anti-hybrid rules, and impose a 50% gross-up penalty on the entire intercompany invoice stream. The RMI Registrar may administratively dissolve the company for failure to maintain a registered agent or for material misstatements in annual filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced when the company is an instrumentality of its principal; the beneficial director is personally liable for all unpaid tax, interest, and penalties, and may face an international arrest warrant with extradition on money-laundering charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / High-Risk Merchant of Record Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing credit-card payments for nutraceutical supplements without an adequate AML/KYC programme, engaging in undisclosed foreign beneficial ownership, or routing cross-border payments through the RMI entity to evade card scheme monitoring.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Marshall Islands Banking Act prohibits unlicensed money transmission; unlicensed activity carries fines of up to USD 250,000 and imprisonment. Payment networks and acquirers may impose network fines, PCI-DSS non-compliance assessments, and permanent merchant account termination with chargeback liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with operational control are personally liable for Banking Act breaches; sanctions include civil forfeiture of merchant settlement proceeds, disqualification from acting as a director in any RMI entity, travel bans pending criminal investigation, and imprisonment of up to five years.
